description: This file defines a set of asynchronous functions that implement a research planning, searching, and synthesis workflow within an agent-based system, using an agent router, web search results, and AI-based content synthesis. It supports tasks like generating search queries, executing web searches via Tavily API, synthesizing findings, and handling dependencies between tasks.

classes.name: SearchQueries
classes.description: Schema for search query generation results

classes.name: ResearchFindings
classes.description: Schema for research findings including citations, confidence, and findings

classes.name: TaskResult
classes.description: Schema representing the result of a research task, including findings, sources, and confidence

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Schema for individual search result citation details

methods.name: SearchQueries generate_search_queries( task_description: str, research_question: str, dependency_context: str = "", )
methods.description: Generates focused web search queries based on a research question and context

methods.name: dict execute_search(queries: List[str])
methods.description: Performs web search queries via Tavily API and returns combined results

methods.name: ResearchFindings synthesize_findings( task_description: str, research_question: str, search_results: dict, )
methods.description: Synthesizes search results into structured findings with citations and confidence assessment

methods.name: TaskResult execute_research_task( task_id: str, task_description: str, research_question: str, )
methods.description: Coordinates search query generation, execution, and synthesis into a comprehensive research task result

methods.name: TaskResult synthesize_from_dependencies( task_id: str, task_description: str, research_question: str, dependency_findings: List[TaskResult], )
methods.description: Synthesizes an answer for a parent task from its child task findings, without web search

methods.name: TaskResult execute_research_task_with_context( task_id: str, task_description: str, research_question: str, dependency_findings: List[TaskResult], )
methods.description: Performs research with enhanced queries generated using dependency context to improve search relevance
